hits.title: Ahrefs Letaido launch adds persistent AI workspace for marketing teams | Venture Post
hits.snippet: SiliconANGLE reported Tuesday that Ahrefs introduced Letaido as an agent-powered marketing workspace for recurring research, reporting and monitoring. Ahrefs positions Agent A as the marketing agent that operates within Letaido. The product is aimed at work such as keyword research, content-gap analysis, site audits, competitor monitoring and client-facing reports. ## What is the difference between Agent A and Letaido? Agent A is the AI marketing agent; Letaido is the shared, persistent environment where its outputs and automations live. Ahrefs says users can create tools, reports, dashboards and workflows in the workspace, save them in a Console view, and share or publish them. The company also says users can schedule recurring jobs, retain files and reference material, and connect third-party services including Slack, HubSpot and WordPress.
